labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Asks for a wider type on Table.title, a new behaviour in the API; feature requests go through Discussions first.

body:
This asks for a new behaviour in Rich's `Table` API (a wider type for `title`), so it is a feature request. New features need approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened, so please start there. Table titles are typed as `TextType` in [rich/table.py](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/table.py). A closely related earlier request, #4171, was closed as not planned. The `Table.grid` approach mentioned in the issue is a workaround that works today.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
